name: Dong Kim Quang festival
nameVi: Lễ hội truyền thống Động Kim Quang
summary: A revolutionary-tradition festival at Động Kim Quang, on the south side of Ba Den, on the 14th of lunar January. The introduction says the old county office there is now in phường Long Hoa. A program was not printed. The solar date and the fee are check on arrival. It is not the Cu Chi tunnels.
when: The 14th of lunar January. Solar date: check on arrival.
